sentences.en: The pay is not adequate for a family of six.
sentences.zh: 六口之家的工资不够充足。

sentences.en: I suppose then an 8-Gigabyte hard drive will be adequate.
sentences.zh: 我认为8GB的硬盘应该足够用了。

sentences.en: I believe our imagination isn't quite adequate to picture it.
sentences.zh: 我相信我们的想象力还不足以想象它。

senses.zh: 足够的，充足的；适当的，恰当的；合格的，差强人意的
